controls.title: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of internal control.
Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities.
The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.
The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.
The entity obtains or generates relevant, quality information to support internal control.
The entity internally communicates information necessary to support the functioning of internal control.
The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting internal control.
The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification of risks.
The entity identifies and analyzes risks to the achievement of its objectives.
The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.
The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact internal control.
The entity selects, develops, and performs evaluations to ascertain whether controls are functioning.
The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner.
The entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risks to acceptable levels.
The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.
The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures.
The entity implements logical access security software and architectures over protected information assets.
The entity registers and authorizes new users and removes credentials when access is no longer authorized.
The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access based on roles, least privilege, and segregation of duties.
The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.
The entity discontinues logical and physical protections over assets only after the ability to read data is removed.
The entity implements security measures to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries.
The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized users and protects it during transit and on endpoints.
The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.
The entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify configuration changes and vulnerabilities.
The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts or security events.
The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could result in a failure to meet objectives.
The entity responds to identified security incidents through a defined incident-response program.
The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from security incidents.
The entity authorizes, designs, develops, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, and software.
The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk-mitigation activities for business disruptions.
The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.
The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity and use of system components.
The entity authorizes, designs, and maintains environmental protections, backup, and recovery infrastructure.
The entity tests recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery.
The entity identifies and maintains confidential information to meet its confidentiality objectives.
The entity disposes of confidential information to meet its confidentiality objectives.
The entity obtains or generates information about processing objectives and uses it over system inputs and outputs.
The entity implements controls over inputs to result in products and services that meet specifications.
The entity implements controls over processing to result in products and services that meet specifications.
The entity implements controls to make outputs complete, accurate, and delivered to meet specifications.
The entity stores inputs and outputs completely, accurately, and in a timely manner.
The entity provides notice to data subjects about its privacy practices.
The entity communicates choices available regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information and obtains consent.
Personal information is collected consistent with the entity's objectives.
The entity obtains explicit consent for sensitive personal information.
The entity limits the use of personal information to the purposes identified in its notice.
The entity retains personal information consistent with its objectives.
The entity securely disposes of personal information.
The entity grants data subjects access to their personal information for review.
The entity corrects, amends, or appends personal information based on data-subject requests.
The entity discloses personal information only with consent of the data subject.
The entity creates and retains a record of authorized disclosures of personal information.
The entity creates and retains a record of unauthorized disclosures of personal information.
The entity obtains commitments from third parties to protect personal information consistent with its objectives.
The entity obtains notification of unauthorized disclosures of personal information by third parties.
The entity provides notification of breaches and incidents to affected parties.
The entity provides an accounting of personal information held and disclosures made to data subjects.
The entity collects and maintains accurate, complete, and relevant personal information.
The entity implements a process for receiving, addressing, and resolving privacy complaints and disputes.
